name: codex-team-playbook
description: Codex team-mode scaffolding for planning and verification, inspired by oh-my-claudecode.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, execute, and verify complex work with a Codex-first team playbook.
interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin that packages reusable planning and verification workflows inspired by oh-my-claudecode. It focuses on task slicing, review discipline, verification, and crisp handoffs while respecting Codex agent constraints.
defaultPrompt: Break this project into planning, execution, and verification tracks.
Create a Codex team brief for this repo change.
Review this change with a dedicated verification track and risks list.
